summary: Add unwired v2 sidebar move and minimal rekey planning

schema.detail: Uses existing typed folder.move and ordered-membership Place operations.

compatibility.detail: Hosts retain existing edit behavior. The pure v2 planner validates complete confirmed inputs, rejects cycles and no-ops, preserves separate folder/member ordering, and refuses oversized atomic edits without truncation. Shared key capacity rejects counts whose vector allocation cannot be represented, rather than panicking.
